arya: Quick plan for FlashAttention v3 canary + backstop ablation test. need a concrete checklist and abort criteria. :eyes:

sam: +1. propose: 1) 5% canary with ff_flashattn_v3=true, 2) backstop config to force paged/fused fallback for that cohort, 3) ablation run toggling off kernel optimizations to compare baseline perf.

maria: put telemetry hooks for these events: flash.attn.choose, flash.attn.fallback, flash.attn.latency_ms. send profiling artifacts to s3://redwood-perf/flashv3/2151234567/

ben: quick perf numbers from local perf-run (seq_len=2048, batch=8):
```
flash_v2 p95 = 47ms, p99 = 110ms
flash_v3 (fused) p95 = 43ms, p99 = 104ms
flash_v3 (paged) p95 = 58ms, p99 = 160ms  # KV miss heavy
```
We need to watch seq_len distribution — paged falls apart on high KV misses.

arya: good notes. let's encode rollout flags and backstop behavior in one place. proposed flags:
```
ff_flashattn_v3 = boolean (canary)
ff_flashattn_v3_mode = [fused, paged, hybrid]
ff_flashattn_backstop = [allow, force_paged, force_v2]
```
Backstop semantics: if backstop=force_paged and runtime detects KV_pressure>0.6 -> route to paged kernel. If error_rate rises -> revert to v2.

sam: abort thresholds (suggestions):
- error rate > 0.5% across canary for 10m -> abort
- p95 latency regression > +10ms vs baseline for 15m -> abort
- p99 > +30ms or tail-error spike -> immediate abort
- model-quality regression (eval set) > 1% -> abort and rollback

maria: add observability checks:
- count(flash.attn.choose{kernel=fused}) and count(...{kernel=paged})
- histograms for flash.attn.latency_ms by seq_len bucket (<=512, 513-1024, 1025-2048, >2048)
- sample traces for 1 in 500 requests with full KV cache stats

ben: ops checklist for canary rollout:
1) create canary cohort (5%) in us-west1
2) enable ff_flashattn_v3=true for cohort
3) set ff_flashattn_v3_mode=fused (primary) and ff_flashattn_backstop=force_paged (safety)
4) enable detailed telemetry and trace sampling
5) run 30m smoke then 3h steady-state profiles
6) run ablation job flipping ff_flashattn_v3_mode=hybrid and ff_flashattn_v3=false to compare
7) collect artifacts -> s3 path above and mark review PR

arya: include automated canary abort in deploy pipeline:
- pipeline checks cloudwatch metrics + our telemetry every 60s
- if any abort threshold hit -> deploy-bot posts and triggers rollback job

deploy-bot: canary started: id=deploy-2151234567-canary cohort=5% region=us-west1 :rocket:

sam: small sample of the smoke-run logs (sanitized):
```
[00:02:13] choose kernel=fused seq_len=128 latency=12ms
[00:02:14] choose kernel=fused seq_len=1024 latency=39ms
[00:02:20] fallback->paged seq_len=2048 kv_miss=0.82 latency=110ms reason=kv_pressure
[00:04:02] error code=E_TIMEOUT path=/v1/generate count=3
```

maria: reminder: run the ablation with profiler flag `--kernel-annotations` so we can attribute time in forward/softmax/permute/kv-copy. otherwise we won't know where paged is eating cycles.

arya: final owner list: canary ops = ben, perf analysis = maria, rollout owner = sam. target: 24h canary then decision. i'll open a PR with the feature flag defs and telemetry docs.

ben: noted. will kick off smoke in 10m and post results here. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: canary smoke done - basic health OK (duration=8m) artifacts uploaded -> s3://redwood-perf/flashv3/2151234567/smoke.tar.gz

arya: thanks team. if anyone spots p95 drift push to #eng-runtime-ops and ping me. we want a fast rollback if we see regression.
